title: Moztopia localization configuration
description: Controls required local and optional remote translation catalogs.

localSource.description: The source adapter used for bundled catalogs.

remoteEnabled.description: Whether updated catalogs should be loaded remotely.

remoteSource.description: The source adapter used for remote catalogs.

remoteLoadMode.description: Load remotely in the background or block initialization until complete.

remoteRepository.description: Public HTTPS GitHub repository containing updated catalogs.

remotePath.description: Path inside the remote repository containing this app's catalogs.

remoteReference.description: Git branch, tag, or commit used for remote catalogs.
